selection: First three complete usable train episode folders encountered in deterministic archive order; no evaluation measurements consulted
frame_layout: RGB PNG, width 640 height 480; one contiguous zero-based frame per train_gt action, including terminal STOP
action_timing: Filename step/action matches train_gt.actions at identical index. Pre-action versus post-action pixel timing is NOT established by extraction/labels; renderer parity must establish it.
